note: Sixth distinct thing attached to February 3rd: Olympics opening, Pope Leo, the budget, three judges and European decisions, and now Iran, Israel and Gaza. The date collects content faster than any other in the corpus and still has no single subject.
He says outright the full manifestation has not arrived and that he only sees fruit. That is a live claim reported honestly as unfulfilled, and it counts.
The geography widens from this area to the whole of North and South America. That lowers the implied rate for any one country while keeping the headline number intact.
Which January is not given. Recorded separately from the plague timing claims because it is a consequence rather than a date.
Worth naming plainly: this is the device by which an early or absent event becomes an early release rather than an error in the word.

The most important passage in the batch. A woman he was told to pray over did not survive, and he says in his own words that he believes it was a miss. A concrete admitted failure with an outcome behind it, not a timing adjustment. Linked to timing-misses-admission and false-prophecies-2020-admitted.
Set against the plague material this does real work: the 350 million fall around the audience and not on them, so the forecast costs the listener nothing.

The most specific electoral call in the corpus: barely keep the House, lose the Senate. It contradicts red-wave-2026 head on and he says so, naming the red wave everybody believes is coming and denying it. Recorded as a contradiction rather than folded in.
Make or break covers both outcomes, so the only real commitment here is the date: a State of the Union on 3 February.
An accusation of demonic possession against a named head of state. Nothing about it can be checked in either direction.
Adds the specific list, eyes, ears, noses, teeth, hair, and organs. Any single verified case would be extraordinary evidence, which makes this one of the highest-stakes claims in the corpus.
Third pushback in two months against his audience's expectation of an imminent departure, after rapture-not-2026 and microwave-jesus-2028.
He narrows it: a financial border rather than no border, with the physical borders remaining. That is a real tightening and makes the claim harder rather than easier.
Both directions count: the storm arriving is the word fulfilled, the storm being survivable is the prayer working.
War and rumours of war are permanently satisfied, so only the plague half carries any weight.
Unusually self-aware. He notices that anyone standing in 2020, or in 2000, would have read their moment the same way, and does not draw the obvious conclusion about his own.
Extends the same pattern to California. Note the softening: the Minnesota shaking is now at a lower level than previously described.
Narrows the cleansing to a state for the first time. Also claims all of 2025 was warning, which is checkable against the corpus.
Unusual among his number sightings: 2030 has a real referent that already carries that date publicly, so seeing the number and hearing the name is not evidence of anything beyond recognition.
He sees both the agenda and the plague and does not say how they connect. Left unjoined rather than joined for him.
Structured so that the agenda advancing means insufficient prayer. Adds Australia to the revival list.
Purple over the games. Purple is never given a meaning here or in purple-three-mountain; a system edge links the two sightings.

He now has the games opening the following Friday, which is 6 February and correct. The third is still the date he prays over, so the wrong start date from November is corrected without the prayer target moving with it.
The eight counts how many times he saw it, not anything in the world. Recorded that way so it is not later read as a death toll or a date.
Fourth telling. He notes a lot of people did not understand it, which is true of the record: the verse has been aimed at ministers in one telling and politicians in another.
Worth recording carefully. He puts distance between himself and the political figure he otherwise promotes, and adds the warning about getting big headed.
Adds the valley of decision running to November, which ties the exemption to the midterms.
